## Payment Terms Editor (PT)

Edits one PaymentTermsField: net period first, the discount pair grouped as one visual unit ("2% if paid within 10 days"), rail last, with the computed shorthand previewed live at the top so the negotiator sees the notation form as they type. Consumed by PaymentTermsField’s own edit format; render-only over @fields.

### Non-goals

No validation policy (which terms are acceptable is the consumer’s rulebook). No currency — terms are time and percentage, money lives elsewhere.
